text:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up — visiting Toronto next week (King West/Kensington area). Looking for quick lunch spots under ~$20 and a late-night poutine/dive option near Sheraton Centre. Any must-tries? Prefer a couple vegan options too.
Tom Blake: Ooh yes. For Kensington: small taco stand + coffee spot on the market, easy and cheap. For vegan try the falafel place on Augusta (cheap, fast).
Priya Rao: If you want sit-down under $20, the ramen-ish noodle bar on King W has weekday lunch bowls that are solid. Not traditional ramen but tasty and quick.
Carlos Mendez: Late-night poutine: there’s a classic diner-counter that does fries+poutine till 2am a few blocks from the Sheraton — small, touristy but iconic. Also Smoke's Poutinerie is nearby if you want loaded options.
Jenna: For vegetarian/vegan sit-downs, there’s a casual spot with bowls/salad wraps on Queen West. Great when the team wants a table.
Aisha Khan: Love it, thanks. Any recs for a quick cheap breakfast near the hotel?
Tom Blake: Hotel breakfast is meh. Walk to the market for a bagel shop — better coffee and cheaper.
Priya Rao: If you have time, grab a peameal bacon sandwich at the market for a local classic (not vegan but iconic).
Carlos Mendez: Quick cheat sheet: 
```
- Kensington: market tacos, falafel on Augusta, coffee roastery
- King West: noodle bar lunch bowls, Queen West vegan bowls
- Late night: diner counter poutine (2am), Smoke's Poutinerie for loaded versions
- Breakfast: bagels + market snacks
```
Aisha Khan: Perfect. Can anyone send a quick walking map or the streetcar lines? Don’t want to rely on data roaming. :sweat_smile:
ops-bot: Note: office travel stipend applies for meals under $30 while traveling 2/23-2/27. Submit receipts within 7 days.
Jenna: If you're on a tight schedule, the King Street streetcar (504) runs right along King West, good for quick hops.
Tom Blake: +1 on the 504. If you’re coming from the Sheraton, it’s an easy 10–15 min walk to King/Kensington depending on pace.
Priya Rao: ping me on Monday and I can DM a quick Google Map with pins.
Aisha Khan: Awesome — appreciate you all. I’ll make a shortlist and share before travel. :raised_hands:
